description: Read DOCX document properties: core properties from the Core Properties part (docProps/core.xml: title, subject, creator, keywords, description, category, content_status, language, identifier, version, last_modified_by, revision, created, modified, last_printed) and extended properties from the Extended File Properties part (docProps/app.xml: application, app_version, company, manager, template). Each value is the element text, or null when the element or the part is absent; core_part and app_part name the parts (null when the package has none). Read-only.

file_path.description: Path to the DOCX or ODT file.

google_doc_id.description: Google Doc ID or URL (alternative to file_path). Extract from URL: docs.google.com/document/d/{ID}/edit

name: get_document_properties
